headline: Iron Ore Futures and Seaborne Quotes Advance on Chinese Exchanges
summary: Iron ore futures and seaborne quotes firmed notably, with the Dalian Commodity Exchange most-traded contract closing up 0.91% at 663.0 yuan per metric ton.

impacts.name: Iron Ore
impacts.why: Rising domestic spot demand and positive exchange contract settlements lift steelmaking raw material prices.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Spot market gains across major ports and firmer futures contract settlements on exchanges drove upward momentum for iron ore valuations.
